references.title: FTC — Buying Platinum, Gold, and Silver Jewelry (consumer guide)
quotes: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or the U.S. registered trademark of the company that will stand behind the mark. ... If you’re thinking about buying a piece of gold jewelry but don’t see a trademark along with the karat mark, don’t buy it.
The phrase “solid gold” means the gold item isn’t hollow. The item will also have a karat mark like 14K or 18K to tell you how much gold is in the item.
A piece of jewelry marked 18K gold is 18 parts gold mixed with six parts of another metal. A piece marked 14K gold is 14 parts gold mixed with 10 parts of another metal.
Find out what others say about a seller. Type its name and the words “complaint” or “review” into a search engine.
references.usedFor: Solid-gold meaning, karat meaning, maker's-mark requirement, seller research

references.title: 16 CFR § 23.3 — Misrepresentation as to gold content
quotes: Such products should not be marked or described as “solid” or as being solidly of gold or of a gold alloy.

An industry product or part thereof, composed throughout of an alloy of gold may be marked and described as “Gold” when such word “Gold,” wherever appearing, is immediately preceded by a correct designation of the karat fineness of the alloy
references.usedFor: What 'solid' may and may not be used for; hollow-centre exclusion

references.title: 16 CFR § 23.10 — Additional guidance for the use of quality marks
quotes: The National Stamping Act provides that any person ... who applies or causes to be applied a quality mark ... shall apply to the article the trademark or name of such person. [15 U.S.C. 297]
references.usedFor: Why the maker's mark matters, not just the karat stamp

references.title: 16 CFR § 23.4 — Misuse of the word 'vermeil'
quotes: An industry product may be described or marked as “vermeil” if it consists of a base of sterling silver coated or plated on all significant surfaces with gold ... a minimum thickness throughout equivalent to two and one half (2 1/2) microns
references.usedFor: Telling vermeil apart from solid gold

flags.title: Gram weight is not published for most listings
flags.detail: 19 of the 27 catalogued listings publish no weight in grams, so the price-vs-gold-value check the checklist asks for cannot be completed from the page. Rule applied: leave the cell blank and flag it. Action: ask the seller for the weight in writing before ordering, then have an independent jeweler weigh and XRF-test the ring on arrival.

flags.title: Most sellers never state 'solid gold' on the listing
flags.detail: Only 4 of 27 rows contain a seller statement that the metal is solid (Avianne title, Jewelry Master description, the VeraByEden FAQ, and two Etsy listing descriptions). The rest merely name the metal, which is not the same claim — the FTC guide defines 'solid gold' as gold that is not hollow, and 16 CFR 23.3 forbids calling a hollow item 'solid'. Blank + flagged.

flags.title: No listing shows a hallmark or maker's mark
flags.detail: Not one of the 27 listings shows a stamp photo or states a hallmark plus maker's mark. The FTC tells buyers not to buy gold jewellery that lacks a trademark beside the karat mark, and 16 CFR 23.10 note 2 (National Stamping Act, 15 U.S.C. 297) requires the maker's name/trademark with a quality mark. This is the single biggest gap in this project: it can only be closed physically, by an independent jeweler inspecting the stamp.

flags.title: Allurez 'Design Your Own' engagement rings are exchange-only, not refundable
flags.detail: Allurez's return policy says: 'Design Your Own engagement rings, pendants, and earrings: May be exchanged for items of the same or higher value, but cannot be exchanged for loose diamonds.' All three Allurez settings in this catalogue are sold through that Design-Your-Own flow (their pages are 'Pick Setting / Pick Stone / Review Your Ring'), so a refund is not available — only an exchange.

flags.title: VeraByEden listing photo asks the buyer to share contact details off-platform
flags.detail: One of the listing photos is a screenshot of a chat with a map pin ('2355 Westwood Boulevard #153 Los Angeles CA 90082 USA') and the text 'Have a nice day. Can you give your address for delivery?' / 'We assure you a quick delivery. Share your contact information with us on Etsy Message.' Moving an order off Etsy removes Etsy Purchase Protection and the case process. Keep any order inside Etsy.

flags.title: VeraByEden: 7-day return window with a 10% restocking fee
flags.detail: The Etsy tab only says 'Returns & exchanges accepted', but the seller's own FAQ says the return must happen 'within 7 days after receiving your item', excludes a '$20 delivery charge' and charges a '10% restocking fee'; the buyer pays return shipping. That materially changes the checklist's return-policy requirement — budget 10% of the price if you return it.

flags.title: The earlier 'below melt value' case study is withdrawn — the price cannot be verified
flags.detail: A previous pass published an Etsy band (7 g '14K solid', shop BUTTERFLYWINGVINTAGE) as selling at 84% of its metal value, using a $444.80 price taken from a search snippet. The live listing today shows 'Sorry, this item is sold out' and NO price. Because the price cannot be read from the seller's page, the below-melt claim is withdrawn and the price cell is blank. The weight ('7g Solid Gold') and the 'Marked 14K' claim do come from the live title and are kept.

This project uses 129.47 USD/g — the lowest published figure — so metal values are conservative. Re-read the spot before acting; this is a snapshot, not a live feed.

flags.detail: The product page promises a 30-day 'Money Back Guarantee (some restrictions apply)' and a 'No Questions Asked' 30-day return policy. The restrictions themselves are absent from the page, so the checklist question about resized/custom exclusions cannot be answered. Ask in writing before ordering.

flags.detail: 'Returns of unworn and unaltered items accepted within 14 days.' That is half the 30-day window offered by Blue Nile and Allurez, and the page does not say whether resizing voids it.

flags.detail: The product page gives karat and weight ('14ky, 4.7g, #B02561') but says 'Call (309) 452-1612 for current pricing and availability' and shows no return terms. Both cells are blank.

flags.title: Three Brilliant Earth prices come from the category listing, not the product page
flags.detail: Nadia, Freesia Hidden Halo and Secret Halo prices were read from the yellow-gold category page. Their product pages were not opened, so the price basis (setting only vs. with stones) and the karat shown on the product page are unconfirmed — karat is blank for those rows.

flags.title: One Etsy 'solid gold' listing also sells vermeil in the same design listing
flags.detail: The CittaliFineJewelry band page lists materials as 'Sterling Silver, Gold Vermeil, 10k, 14k, 18k Solid Gold' — the same product page offers vermeil, which is gold-plated sterling silver under 16 CFR 23.4. When a listing mixes vermeil and solid variants, the buyer must select the exact karat variant and keep the order confirmation showing it.

flags.title: Etsy prices are 'from' prices for one variant of a design family
flags.detail: Several Etsy listings sell one design across 2–8 mm widths and 10K/14K/18K metals, with prices like 'from $251.30' or a range '$547.26 - $2,410.13'. The recorded figure is the lowest 14K configuration shown, not the price of the pictured ring. Re-check the exact variant before relying on any figure.

flags.title: The Allurez 18K 'variant' is a different style number, not the same SKU
flags.detail: The 14K filigree setting is style U5882 at $1,085 with 5.00 g; the 18K page linked from its metal selector is style U5885 at $1,316 with 5.90 g. Same design family, different SKU — so the karat price difference also includes a different amount of metal.

flags.title: Allurez weights are explicitly 'Approximate'
flags.detail: 'Gold Weight 5.00 Grams (Approximate)', '4.80 grams (Approximate)', 'Approximate Metal Weight 3.58 grams'. Metal values computed from these are estimates, and the actual ring may weigh a little more or less.

flags.title: Independent reputation checks were completed for only 2 of 8 sellers
flags.detail: Blue Nile (BBB) and VeraByEden (Etsy shop metrics + review count) have verified reputation data. Brilliant Earth, Allurez, Avianne & Co, The Jewelry Master and Solid Gold Jewelers do not — their reputation cells are blank. The FTC guide tells buyers to search '<seller> complaint' and '<seller> review' before buying; the Sellers page links a manual-review search for each.

flags.title: Accepted payment methods are not documented for most sellers
flags.detail: Sellers advertise financing (Affirm, Klarna, Shop Pay, Wells Fargo, layaway) but none of the captured pages lists its accepted payment methods. The checklist's 'use a credit card' requirement therefore stays partially unverified — the refund wording confirms cards are used, but not the full list.
